description: This Java class serves as a factory for creating SASL authenticators within the Eclipse Hono project. It implements the ProtonSaslAuthenticatorFactory interface and provides mechanisms to instantiate HonoSaslAuthenticator objects, relying on an AuthenticationService to handle the actual authentication logic. The class includes constructors that utilize dependency injection for integrating with Vert.x environment and authentication helpers.

classes.name: HonoSaslAuthenticatorFactory
classes.description: A factory class implementing ProtonSaslAuthenticatorFactory, responsible for creating HonoSaslAuthenticator instances that handle SASL authentication for AMQP connections in the Eclipse Hono framework. It leverages an AuthenticationService for credential verification.
